definitions.full: H5206. nidah נִידָה noun feminine id. (on form compare Ges § 20 , 3, R. 1 Kö ii. 1, 497 ); — of Jerusalem Lam 1:8 (= נִדָּה 1:17 ). II. נדד (√ of following, see Kö ii. 1, 42 ; compare Arabic high hill, hill rising high into the sky , Lane 2778 ; also earth-heap, sand-heap ).
